The team has facilitated equipment procurements, refurbishments, and upgrades to components in preparation for re-start. The team, comprised of Sandia National Laboratories (Sandia or SNL), Flowserve, and Sporian Microsystems, has decades of experience designing and operating molten salt valves, sensors, pumps and thermal transport salt systems at high temperatures, and plan to use this unique opportunity of starting a large scale frozen loop to establish protocols, test useful forensic techniques, identify crucial component states, and advance the final loop capabilities during the restart of MSTL. Project Status: On track • New National Instruments hardware has been installed and wired to support the new control system. • The UPS battery backup and air compressor are being rebuilt • Valves, pumps, and heat trace have all been rebuild and checkout out. • Modeling and Simulation has been completed on how best to melt the salt for the system 28 12.
